Name: (AT) Big Jack Halloween Decor
Author: MossiMods
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
3 Versions of AT for Deluxe Tree - A face cutout for your character to walk behind and peek through, and 2 regular standees - one with an unlit face, the other with a lit face. (It doesn't put put off light)
[b][color=#980000] NO AI -[/color][/b] This mod was drawn by hand, pixel by pixel. 

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]
you can hit "I" on your keyboard  to spawn the Deluxe Tree right away,
then using the Paint Bucket Tool (which you can also spawn using the CJB Item Spawner) hover down at 
the bottom until your cursor becomes a hand to change its Texture! 

To peek through the Cut Out Board, you need to walk above it, then slowly inch yourself downward 
until you line your Farmer's face up behind the square cut out.... may take a few tries, but it works 


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip into your Stardew Valley Mods Folder[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/size]
